title: Bat with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>

    <path d='M50 42 C38 34 26 30 12 34 C18 40 20 44 18 50 C24 48 28 50 26 56 C32 52 36 54 34 60 C40 54 46 52 50 56 Z' fill='#8e5bd0' stroke='#b98af0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
    <path d='M50 42 C62 34 74 30 88 34 C82 40 80 44 82 50 C76 48 72 50 74 56 C68 52 64 54 66 60 C60 54 54 52 50 56 Z' fill='#8e5bd0' stroke='#b98af0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linejoin='round'/>

    <path d='M50 44 C40 38 30 35 20 37 C24 41 25 44 23 48 C29 48 32 51 30 55 C36 53 40 55 39 59 C43 55 47 52 50 54 Z' fill='#a86fe0'/>
    <path d='M50 44 C60 38 70 35 80 37 C76 41 75 44 77 48 C71 48 68 51 70 55 C64 53 60 55 61 59 C57 55 53 52 50 54 Z' fill='#a86fe0'/>

    <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='15' ry='18' fill='#7b4fc0' stroke='#b98af0' stroke-width='2'/>

    <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='9' ry='11' fill='#c9a8f0'/>

    <path d='M41 48 L38 34 L48 44 Z' fill='#8e5bd0' stroke='#c9a8f0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>

    <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='13' fill='#8e5bd0' stroke='#b98af0' stroke-width='2'/>
    <!-- sparkly eyes -->
    <g>
      <circle cx='45' cy='51' r='3' fill='#ffffff'/>
      <circle cx='45.5' cy='50.5' r='1.6' fill='#fff7a8'/>
      <circle cx='44.2' cy='51.8' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx='55' cy='51' r='3' fill='#ffffff'/>
      <circle cx='55.5' cy='50.5' r='1.6' fill='#fff7a8'/>
      <circle cx='54.2' cy='51.8' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
    </g>
    <!-- tiny sparkle stars near eyes -->
    <path d='M40 45 l1 2 2 1 -2 1 -1 2 -1 -2 -2 -1 2 -1 Z' fill='#fff7a8'/>
    <path d='M60 45 l1 2 2 1 -2 1 -1 2 -1 -2 -2 -1 2 -1 Z' fill='#fff7a8'/>
    <!-- nose -->
    <path d='M48 57 L52 57 L50 59 Z' fill='#e05a9b'/>
    <!-- smile -->
    <path d='M46 60 Q50 63 54 60' fill='none' stroke='#e05a9b' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- little fangs -->
    <path d='M47.5 60.5 L47.5 63 L49 61 Z' fill='#ffffff'/>
    <path d='M52.5 60.5 L52.5 63 L51 61 Z' fill='#ffffff'/>
